title: SEG Topic Normalization
description: Bridges a source taxonomy category (e.g., Tintinalli chapterTitle) to SEG canonical topicIds. No Qbank question is modified; this layer normalizes source categories only. Multiple candidates and uncertainty are preserved.

sourceCategory.description: Raw source category as stored in Qbank (e.g., Tintinalli chapterTitle, Rosen chapterTitle). Truncated values are kept verbatim to preserve uncertainty.

candidateTopicIds.description: 0-3 SEG canonical topicIds that this source category may correspond to. Empty when no safe bridge exists (uncertainty high).

confidence.description: High: direct clinical domain match. Medium: probable requiring review. Low: uncertain. Unmapped: no safe candidate.

uncertainty.description: Human-readable reason for uncertainty (e.g., truncated source title, broad chapter, multiple possible topics).

evidenceBasis.description: Evidence that produced the bridge, in priority order.

status.description: Lifecycle of this normalization entry. AUTO_MAPPED/VERIFIED only for High confidence with curated evidence.
